extracted.name: Scandi beetroot & salmon pasta
extracted.description: Eat well at work with this easy-to-prepare Scandinavian-inspired beetroot and salmon fusilli salad. It'll keep you going through the afternoon
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp fat-free Greek yogurt mixed with 1 tbsp water
instruction_lines: Cook the fusilli following pack instructions, then drain and leave to cool. Toss the pasta with the beetroot, avocado, cucumber, dill, yogurt and horseradish, then season generously with black pepper.
Gently mix the salmon and rocket through the pasta, then tip into your lunchbox or an airtight container.
